notes: and that is one rendering of the second waw under rule 55, contiguous at the clause's left edge; the alternative heads it on that.
any of is given to the partitive מִן, this clause writing no כֹּל.
The article on תּוֹעֵבֹת takes the demonstrative these written in its place (rule 41), no demonstrative morpheme being present here, unlike LEV.18.26–29.
